# netactuate_billing_packages (Data Source)

Reads Billing Packages visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_billing_packages" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `billing_packages` (List of Object) List of billing packages for the authenticated account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--billing_packages))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
